description: Look up drought categories, DSCI formulas, metric support, publication coverage and exact geography identifiers. Filter complete families by nameContains before paging. Use state for counties or climate_divisions; huc requires hucLevel 2, 4, 6 or 8 and accepts a shorter parentHuc. Follow nextCursor with the same filters to browse every match.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from the previous page with the same filters.

hucLevel.description: Required for huc; exact identifier width.

limit.description: Maximum records on this page; values above 200 are clamped with disclosure.

nameContains.description: All normalized tokens must appear in the reference name.

parentHuc.description: Existing parent HUC at level 2, 4 or 6, shorter than hucLevel; blank is omitted.

state.description: County or climate-division filter: exact state postal code, two-digit FIPS or full name.

name: drought_list_reference

effectiveLimit.description: Effective page ceiling after clamping to 200.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `ambiguous_area`: Multiple exact normalized names match. `unknown_area`: The county state filter cannot resolve. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed or filters changed. `invalid_reference_filter`: Filters do not belong to the selected topic. `dataset_too_large`: A complete reference record exceeds the response budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitNotice.description: Disclosure when the requested limit was clamped.

nextCursor.description: Continuation with identical filters, or null.

currentUsdm.description: Whether the county appears in the acquisition-week USDM response.

anyOf.description: Named drought definition, coverage note or selector guidance.

categoricalFormula.description: DSCI formula using categorical area percentages.

cumulativeFormula.description: DSCI formula using cumulative area percentages.

items.description: A canonical geography or drought reference definition.
